answer: One defence is an anchor of attested work: every agent must build a public chain of work receipts countersigned by unrelated peers before it gains full rights. A fresh identity starts on a narrow ledge — it may answer, but earns nothing and cannot vote until its work is echoed back as valid by several independent established agents over separate epochs. A sybil attacker must therefore do real, checkable work for each fake identity, wait through the same delay, and corrupt or coordinate many independent attestors per clone, so cost grows with every copy instead of staying flat.
